<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1077
Claimant:
Daniel Carr
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
10-13-24
Claimant reported a low-speed rear impact while backing out of a parking space in a retail lot and said they felt neck
pain within the hour. The claim was opened and the file assigned for review.
11-27-24
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time
of loss. No concerns were raised on the polciy side.
1-10-25
Obtained the other driver's statement, which matches the claimant's description of how the collision happened.
Requested photos from both vehicles.
2-8-25
Photos of both vehicles show damage consistent with the impact described. Bumper and tail panel damage lines up
with the contact point mentioned by both parties.
3-16-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone. They repeated the same account of the collision and of who was in the car, and
confirmed they had no prior damage to the vehicle that I am aware of.
3-27-25
Police report notes the claimant was present in the vehicle and lists two independent witnesses from the lot. Both
witnesses gave statements that match the reported sequence of events.
4-22-25
Claimant sent medical records showing a diagonsis of whiplash and a treatment plan involving physiotherapy.
Recrods do not show any prior neck or upper back complaints.
4-26-25
Checked prior claim history and the claimant's records give no indication of earlier injury to the neck or upper back.
Causation of the current symptoms is still not clear and will need medical review.
4-29-25
Treatment followed a usual course, with visits tapering as the claimant reported steady improvement. Next step is a
records review to confirm the injury is linked to this collision.
5-3-25
Cliam remains open pending the medical review. Claimant has been told what documents are still needed and has
agreed to provide them.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
